content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The 12 Southern Railway Level 1 posts are distributed at two posts each among Chennai, Tiruchchirappalli, Madurai, Palakkad, Thiruvananthapuram and Salem divisions. The advertised posts are open to all eligible candidates irrespective of community. There is no separate reservation for any community under the Scouts and Guides Quota.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess any one of the following qualifications: Passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination with at least 50% marks in aggregate; or Passed Matriculation from a recognized board with a Course Completed Act Apprenticeship for technician categories; or Passed Matriculation from a recognized board with an ITI qualification approved by NCVT for technician categories. The requirement of 50% marks in Class 12 is not applicable to SC, ST and ex-servicemen candidates or candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12. Candidates must possess one of the following qualifications: Class 10 pass; or ITI or an equivalent qualification; or National Apprenticeship Certificate granted by NCVT; or Class 10 with ITI; or Class 10 with a National Apprenticeship Certificate granted by NCVT.

content_sections.heading: Scouts and Guides Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy all the following Scouts and Guides requirements: Must be a President’s Scout, Guide, Rover or Ranger, or a Himalayan Wood Badge holder in any section. Must have been an active member of a Scouts organization for the last five years. Must possess a Certificate of Activeness in the prescribed format. Must have attended two events at the National Level or All Indian Railway level. Must have attended two events at the State Level.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit as on 1 January 2027
content_sections.text: Serving Railway employees with the prescribed continuous or broken service may receive relaxation up to 40 years for UR, 43 years for OBC and 45 years for SC/ST candidates. Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated but not remarried may receive relaxation up to 35 years for UR, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC/ST. Eligible Jammu and Kashmir domiciled candidates may receive five years of relaxation. Eligible Casual Administrative Office staff may receive age relaxation according to the prescribed conditions. Ex-servicemen will receive relaxation according to applicable service and category rules.

content_sections.heading: Medical Examination
content_sections.text: Candidates recommended for appointment must satisfy the prescribed medical classification of Bee Two and above for posts identified by Southern Railway or Integral Coach Factory.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Upload
content_sections.text: Scanned copies of Scouts and Guides qualification certificates. Certificate of Activeness and details of attended events. Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets. Proof of date of birth. Community certificate, where applicable. Age-relaxation certificate, where applicable. Fee-exemption certificate, where applicable. Recent passport-size colour photograph in Scouts or Guides uniform. Scanned signature.

content_sections.heading: Photograph and Signature Requirements
content_sections.text: The photograph should be recent and not older than three months. It must show the candidate in Scouts or Guides uniform with a clear front-facing view. The photograph should be in JPG or JPEG format at 100 DPI. The prescribed photograph size is 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm. The file size should be between 50 KB and 100 KB. The signature should be made on white paper in black ink. The signature file should be in JPG or JPEG format at 100 DPI. The signature file size should be between 10 KB and 40 KB.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the RRC Chennai website at www.rrcmas.in. Open Employment Notice No. RRC-01/S&G/2026-27. Read the detailed eligibility conditions and application instructions. Complete the online registration using an active mobile number and email address. Select Level 1 or Level 2 and enter the required details. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting certificates. Pay the applicable examination fee through the online payment gateway. Review the application carefully and submit it before 18 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. Save or print the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 17 Level 1 and Level 2 posts are available in Southern Railway and Integral Coach Factory.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Quota Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 18 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Southern Railway Level 2 posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must generally have passed Class 12 with at least 50% marks or possess Matriculation with the prescribed Act Apprenticeship or NCVT-approved ITI qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Southern Railway Scouts and Guides recruitment?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 for general applicants and Rs. 250 for SC, ST, ex-servicemen, PwBD, female, transgender, minority and economically backward-class candidates. The prescribed amount is refundable to eligible candidates who appear in the examination after bank charges are deducted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Scouts and Guides Quota?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 60-mark Written/Hybrid Examination and 40 marks awarded for eligible Scouts and Guides certificates and activities.
